about: INF-06 per-tip SIM pastes (il_sim_scene.py --paste-by-tip KEY:preset=NAME), from Process's measured reference docs/research/paste-model-reference-per-tip.md (11-04). Values marked 'fit' are chosen so SimPasteReferenceTest lands on that reference; the rest are measured. The 25G's sub-turn behaviour is not modelled (wholeTurnsOnly, PM 11-04) and its sub-turn values stay provisional until Process's per-contact weighing.

22g-bent.mRevMg: §1: 169 mg / 160 half turns at ~19 psi (10-28, one weighing)
22g-bent.footprint: fit: §2 half-turn mean area on a flat blank, no pad, as the SIM blank: 0.94 mm2 (10-31), not the masked 0603 rows (board 3's 0.788 is pad-capped, Process 11-04; p29's 0.747 is on the same pads); c 0.911 lays 0.940 (the SIM's phase-averaged mean); e 0.77 is the SIM's law (unverified, §2)
22g-bent.cv: fit: §2 area CV 7.5 % (board 3) at the balanced phase (7.6 % mean over 100 seeds); of pad-capped dots: the flat blank's row has no CV
22g-bent.ripple: fit: §3 A 0.56-0.60 as tools/lumen.py fits it: f(phi) = 1 + A cos(phi - peak) the flow per degree, dot area the dose proxy, consecutive half turns (the tip bead carries paste between them); 1.23 gives A 0.579. Above 1 the flow goes negative over part of a turn, so a sub-turn dot near the trough lays nothing: this preset is for half and whole turns, as the reference
22g-bent.transferRatio: fit: the swing A depends on it (each dot leaves 1 - 0.75 of its paste on the tip for the next): set here, not taken from the SIM's base paste
22g-bent.emptyDotsAfterPowerCycle: §5: ~12 empty half-turn dots after a power cycle
22g-bent.newPhaseOnMotorOff: §4: every motor-off, a uniform random phase

25g-plastic.mRevMg: §1: +39 mg / 20 whole turns at 13.7 psi (11-04 02:37, one weighing; repeat pending)
25g-plastic.footprint: fit: §2 whole turn on flat FR4, no pad, as the SIM blank: ~1.50 mm2 (the 20 weighed dots, 11-04 02:2x; the bare-Cu rows 1.29 and 1.58-1.71 are an edge-fit core and a dot with its tail, Process 11-04); c 0.862 lays 1.44 (-4 %)
25g-plastic.cv: fit: §2 area CV 5.7 % on flat FR4, no pad (the 20 weighed dots, Process 11-04): 5.67 % mean over the test's 16 seeds
25g-plastic.transferRatio: fit: the CV depends on it (the tip bead averages successive dots): set here, not taken from the SIM's base paste
25g-plastic.landingSdMm: §7: 0.04-0.06 on the board, 0.02-0.05 on the tile
25g-plastic.maxGapMm: §6: dots land alike over 0.10-0.30 (drag at 0.05 not modelled)
25g-plastic.threadShare: §6: 0 threads with the cure (13.7 psi, 3 mm lift + 0.5 s); the strings without it are not modelled
25g-plastic.wholeTurnsOnly: §2-3 + PM 11-04 04:4x: sub-turn dots follow a threshold and their history, not a cosine
